1.consolidated_definition: Crema. Crema para limpiar y suavizar la piel. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Yo para desmaquillarme uso solo el gel limpiador cold cream de avene (antes con otros limpiadores) y con eso me basta y sé que no daño la piel (Tu Rinconcito.com, 14-01- 04)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Cold cream. A cleansing and moisturizing cream for the skin. Raw anglicism, relatively infrequent. I use only the cold cream gel cleanser from Avene (previously with other cleansers) to remove makeup, and that is sufficient for me, as I am certain it does not harm my skin.
